title: What If You Lived on a TRAPPIST-1 Planet? Seven Worlds in the Sky

scenes.text: What if you lived on a TRAPPIST-1 planet? Your sky would hold other worlds.
The star is 40 light-years away and hosts seven Earth-size planets.
All seven orbit closer to their star than Mercury orbits our Sun.
The planets sit so close together that each could appear in the others' skies.
The farthest planet circles its star in only 19 days. A year would pass faster than a month.
Three planets sit where liquid water could exist, under a sun that gives off 0.05 percent of our Sun's energy.
